_about: The default camera of each place (Fable Nov 19, Part 2; Fable Nov 21: +6 degrees everywhere, the owner's decision, replacing +4). pitch_bonus = degrees added to every camera preset at the DEFAULT of the five look-down presets (V cycles +6 / +8 / +10 / +12 / +14: the others add 2, 4, 6 and 8 degrees to this number and stand 3 % further out per step); distance = how far the camera stands (1.0 = as everywhere).
